rooms.description: A broad band of slanted windows holds a tilted grey sea. Beneath it, a continuous blue-black console folds radar and weather screens around a radio cradle, a clipped logbook and a narrow corkboard.
rooms.feeling: Alert, with the gale always in view.

rooms.description: From just above the gritty deck, steel benches converge on a rack of clear sample cylinders. Teal water lines cross the aisle overhead, fluorescent strips catch beads of condensation, and two squat pumps shiver on rubber mounts.
rooms.feeling: Humid and insistent, with a thrum felt through the deck.

rooms.description: A straight-on grid of violet-grey monitors fills the far wall, their faint plots reflected on a clean desktop. Low computer cases sit beneath it, and squared slips of pencilled diagrams barely break the alignment.
rooms.feeling: Cool and absorbed, with the hush of a room where people think.

rooms.description: An oval bolted table fills the view from above, ringed by mismatched mugs under an amber pendant. At the back, a coffee pot steams beside the galley fridge and a corkboard crowded with curling photographs.
rooms.feeling: Warm and familiar, with the morning routine still carrying on.

rooms.description: Soft ceiling light washes a broad patch of pale floor between the examination bed and flush, latched cabinets. A compact diagnostic screen folds against the wall, and a shallow report desk holds a single closed folder.
rooms.feeling: Quiet and ready for whoever comes through the door.

rooms.description: From the threshold, four close-set cabin doors on either side make a rhythm of tall frames and recessed handles. A far cabin stands ajar, spilling honey-yellow light across the runner and catching the curled heel of a slipper.
rooms.feeling: Close and private, like passing sleeping cabins before breakfast.

rooms.description: The back of an empty swivel chair frames a laptop under two mismatched monitors. Camera straps and headphone leads loop across the old survey bench, charger lights blink red, and thumbnail sketches curl at their pins.
rooms.feeling: Restless and improvised, with an edit halfway through.

rooms.description: Tall green parts bins climb the bulkhead above a vise. A bare work light throws wrench shadows across pinned diagrams, while a running test rig and a caged maintenance terminal share the scarred bench.
rooms.feeling: Loud and purposeful, with every surface within reach.

people.description: Broad shoulders taper to a slim waist in a fitted navy blazer. His swept-back silver hair exposes a long forehead above a neat smile, and he leans in with one palm open and the other thumb tapping his cuff.
people.feeling: Polished and engaging, with a quickening tempo.

people.description: Tall and straight through the shoulders, she wears a charcoal uniform with a flat collar. Pale window light edges her tight grey braid and square jaw as she clasps her hands behind her and looks past the viewer.
people.feeling: Steady and deliberate, with her attention still on the ship.

people.description: A slight upper body broadens into the teal fleece pooled over her lap. Screen glow catches her blunt black bob, rounded cheeks and tired lower lids as she looks up from a notebook held open under both thumbs.
people.feeling: Approachable and attentive, with fatigue around the eyes.

people.description: Stocky and thick-necked in olive coveralls, he hunches over a rag and wipes grease from his knuckles. Hard light picks out close-cropped curls, a broad nose and stubble as he watches his hands.
people.feeling: Worn down and matter-of-fact, with hands that keep working.

people.description: In profile, her slight frame curves from a bowed neck through one rounded shoulder. Soft light falls on a high cheekbone and close copper curls. She folds her hands against a plum scrub top and glances sideways.
people.feeling: Patient and attentive, leaving room for the other person to speak.

people.description: Lanky and long-limbed, he leans back on one hip, hands pocketed in a loose rust windbreaker. A pool of lamplight catches his crooked grin, pointed chin and unruly blond forelock as his eyes follow someone off to the side.
people.feeling: Easy company, already catching the next conversation.
